hooks.name: Spec sync
hooks.description: When a spec's tasks.md is saved, make the agent check each ticked task against the code, so the spec never claims work that is not built.

action.prompt: A spec task list was just saved. For every task marked [x], confirm the files and functions it names exist in src/ and that a test covers it. Untick any task that is not really built, and update design.md if a file or function name changed. Do not edit code to make a task true. Report what you changed in one short list.
